result.title: ShoWorld: Shape-Faithful Multi-Hypothesis Occupancy World Model
result.summary: Occupancy world models struggle to forecast moving objects due to motion uncertainty and shape distortion. A single trajectory can average plausible futures into an implausible path, and repeated re-voxelization can erode or inflate object shape even under correct motion. We introduce ShoWorld to address these challenges through separate motion and shape representations. The motion forecaster predicts probabilistic trajectories conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the future ego trajectory. Each hypothesis is rendered into occupancy and fused according to its probability to retain alternative futures. The shape component predicts sub-voxel points with occupancy probabilities and offsets from local geometry. These points move rigidly with the object, and voxel occupancy follows the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it. This representation reduces shape distortion under motion. ShoWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on Occ3D-nuScenes. With ground-truth occupancy and ego trajectory, it improves mIoU and IoU by 6.56 and 9.16 points overall and by 6.06 and 5.53 points on dynamic classes.

AI.brief_summary: ShoWorld 是面向自动驾驶的占据世界模型，将「运动」与「形状」解耦：运动模块在场景布局与自车轨迹条件下预测多条概率化轨迹并按概率融合渲染占据，形状模块以带占据概率和偏移的 sub-voxel 点随物体刚性运动，以缓解多模态未来平均与重复体素化造成的形状失真。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按概率保留多种未来假设的融合方式与 sub-voxel 点表示刚性携带几何，或可为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的维护和几何细节在状态更新中的保真提供方法借鉴，但属于 3D 占据预测，需核查能否用于 VLM 内部状态。
